name: mentor
description: Keep hold of what a coding agent does to your code. It works on its own, and stops at the end of each step of its plan until you have seen what the step changed, where it fits and what it can break. Ask which type or function to use in plain words, and get any symbol's card, the package map and the path a call takes, all from the compiler's view of the code, on your machine.

settings.label: Open Mentor in
settings.description: The sidebar, a tab of the bottom panel, or a window you can move.

settings.label: Show uses above declarations
settings.description: One line above each Go type and function: how many things use it, how many tests reach it, how many types implement it. A click shows its card.

settings.label: Watch the coding agent
settings.description: Mentor holds the agent to its plan and stops it at each step's checkpoint. Off: Mentor lets the agent work as it would without it, and does not connect to it; the Explore and Changes tabs still work.

settings.label: Agent: connect by itself
settings.description: When a folder opens, add Mentor's MCP server and hooks to the agent for it, so its plan and checkpoints come here. Off: connect with Mentor: Connect the Agent.

settings.label: Agent: plan first
settings.description: The agent proposes its plan in steps, and you approve it in Mentor, before it changes code.

settings.label: Agent: files per step
settings.description: A step that would change more files than this ends at a checkpoint first. 0 for no limit.

settings.label: Leave out
settings.description: Files to leave out of the index, comma-separated globs on paths from the folder: gen/**, *_mock.go. vendor and testdata are always left out.

settings.label: Build tags
settings.description: Read the code as go build -tags would, such as integration.

settings.label: Semantic search
settings.description: Find code by meaning as well as by words, with embeddings from a local Ollama. Nothing leaves your machine.

settings.label: Embedding model
settings.description: An embedding model Ollama has pulled, such as nomic-embed-text.
